releases.title: El hormiguero

The show won the Entertainment prize at the 2009 Rose d'Or ceremony.

releases.title: The Traitors

releases.title: Days of Our Lives

releases.title: Beyond the Gates

At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where our characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life … and some with more grace than others.

The coverage can also include analysis from experts on the issues, commonly featured in or after the taped reports.

releases.title: The Five
releases.synopsis: The Five is an American news and talk show on Fox News Channel featuring a rotating panel who discuss current stories, political issues, and pop culture. The show premiered in July 2011, replacing the Glenn Beck program, and airs on weekdays at 5:00 p.m. ET with replays at 4:00 a.m. ET. On October 3, 2011, after successful ratings and high popularity, Fox News announced that The Five would become the permanent 5 p.m. series, as the program had previously been announced to last only during the summer. The Five is currently the second-most-watched program in all of cable news in the United States, placing only behind The O'Reilly Factor, also on the Fox News Channel. The program has occasionally been the number one rated cable news series in the key 25 to 54 viewing demographic.

releases.title: Loose Women

releases.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
releases.synopsis: A Bangers & Cash spin-off series that follows the journey of a vehicle purchased at a Mathewsons classic car auction, before being repaired, restored and then re-auctioned in order to try and find the vehicle a new home and loving owner. These genuine restoration projects, with varying degrees of difficulty, show how tricky it can really be to restore classic vehicles back to their former glory. Derek, Paul and Dave Mathewson are on hand to share their advice and observations on the variety of different jobs, which include an MG Montego Turbo with its engine in the boot, and a rare Lotus Elan S1 that hasn't seen a road for 47 years.

releases.title: Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi

Its tone is somewhat lighter than a regular news broadcast, though reports are filed from the usual ABC News correspondents. Weather and pop culture stories round out the reports.

releases.title: The Beat with Ari Melber
releases.synopsis: The Beat with Ari Melber delivers the biggest political and news stories of the day, with interviews and original reporting from around the nation. An Emmy-winning journalist, attorney and former Senate staffer, Melber cuts through the spin and the noise to tell you what's really happening. Real news, every night.

releases.title: Crimewatch Live
releases.synopsis: Presented by former Metropolitan Police detective Rav Wilding, the show appeals directly to the public for help with unsolved cases from all over the UK. He's joined by Michelle Ackerley, who will be hitting the road, finding out how police forces up and down the country are tackling the everyday sorts of crime that affects us all.Live every weekday morning, the series features reconstructions, CCTV and Wanted Faces alongside fascinating insights into the latest crime fighting technology and advice on how viewers can avoid becoming a victim themselves.

releases.title: Deadline: White House
releases.synopsis: Hosted by Nicolle Wallace, this program provides in-depth reporting and dynamic discussions on the political stories driving the news cycle. Nicolle Wallace brings viewers the latest political developments of the day, in addition to interviews with leading newsmakers and influential politicians. Drawing on her years of experience as communications chief for President George W. Bush and senior advisor for the McCain-Palin campaign, Wallace provides political insight and clarity on where key decision-makers stand on complex issues.

releases.title: Ring of Honor Wrestling

releases.title: Classic Movies: The Story of...
releases.synopsis: Classic Movies: The Story of... goes in search of the cinematically sublime. Those films that have transcended their era to enter the pantheon of greats.With each episode devoted to a single film, their story will be told with detail, affection, looking for the truth behind the myth, all the trials and triumphs that went into forging a classic. But this isn't simply history, the standard making of, it's about identifying those ingredients immortal scenes, performances, themes, luxuriant cinematography, art direction, special effects, music, even the power of a single line – that elevate a film to a new level.Hosted by Ian Nathan, guide us through the story from inception to legacy, supplemented with regular input along with special guest, with unique insight, historians who have devoted entire books, and visit to special location, where they shot or that served as  a key inspiration, bringing each of these films to life with a dynamic presentation. We are on a journey to find out not what makes a film good, but what makes it classic.

As such, NFL Live is not a highlight show, as Sunday and Monday game highlights are handled by the various other NFL studio shows, including NFL Primetime during the season. Unlike shows for other sports, NFL Live even runs throughout the entire off season.

The show has been a part of the Fox News program lineup since 1998 and is the number one cable news broadcast in its time slot.

releases.title: Sam & Ade Go Birding
releases.synopsis: Sam & Ade Go Birding follows good friends Samuel West and Adrian Edmondson on a spectacular birdwatching quest across the British Isles. For Sam, birding is a long-standing passion - he's been recording his sightings for twenty years and has now seen over 400 British species, though he'll always grab any opportunity to add to his list. For Adrian, the hobby is something new: he's bird-curious. Despite living in the countryside for more than twenty years, Ade's frustrated not to know more about the birds around him and now wants to learn with his enthusiastic friend - if they can stop for lunch, stay in a nice cottage and have the odd pint along the way.   Across three weekend adventures, the pair travel to West Cornwall in search of Cornish Choughs, waders and transatlantic visitors blown hundreds of miles off course; to North Norfolk, on a wild goose chase for Brent and Pink-footed geese; and finally, to the Somerset Levels, where they stake out Kingfishers, Egrets and the elusive Bittern.   Featuring exquisite photography and breathtaking landscapes, the series is as much about friendship as it is about wildlife. Between sightings, Sam and Ade share thoughtful, funny, and moving conversations on everything from obsession and ageing to acting, childhood memories, losing a parent and the geeky hobbies that have captivated them over the years.

None of them, even three stronger than god masters, whose power could pierce the heavens, have been able to return alive. However, a boy that's being chased by various people because he alone holds a priceless treasure jumps off the cliff, but instead of dying he wakes up in the body of a boy with the same name in another world. This is the story of a boy wielding the Sky Poison Pearl, cultivating the strength to oppose heaven and earth, a lord overlooking the world. —Novel Updates

As he sets his foot deeper into the island, he realises nothing is what it seems, and the truth might cost him his soul.

releases.synopsis: A stoic mortician endowed with the ability to perceive the deceased finds his quiet existence upended when the dramatic spirit of a high-profile influencer refuses to depart, forcing him into an unauthorized investigation to prove her sudden demise was the result of homicide.

releases.title: Indigo Elsewhere
releases.synopsis: At the edge of an unnamed city, two unemployed, directionless trans lesbians connect in a reality-shifting way.

releases.title: The Storm
releases.synopsis: Filip is turning 45, and has invited his closest friends for dinner at his and his wife's lavish and newly bought farm estate up north in Sweden. What they don't know is that a ferocious storm is on its way and that they'll be trapped together. Their polished acts fall, and an unfiltered meltdown starts. When the panic starts to creep in and they all realise the seriousness of the situation, the farm starts to shrink, secrets spill out, and unexpected feelings take shape.

releases.title: The Ambitious
releases.synopsis: The year is 2023, and elections are nearing in Goma, a Congolese city of one million people situated near the border with genocide-ravaged Rwanda. It is a region rich in valuable natural resources, where bloody conflicts over ethnic and economic issues have been raging for three decades, devastating eastern Congo. Two members of the La Lucha civil society movement decide to abandon activism in favour of a career in politics. Espoir, a young activist, stands as a candidate for the National Assembly on behalf of the opposition. Sankara who, confined to a wheelchair, has become a symbol of resistance, joins the outgoing president’s coalition. When rebel troops from the M23 group enter Goma, their dreams of democracy are thrown into doubt.

releases.title: Opt Out
releases.synopsis: Four friends from a long-buried crime are brought back together by a coded text, only to learn that the secret they thought was safe has come unraveled.

releases.title: Maserati: The Brothers
releases.synopsis: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

releases.title: Backwoods
releases.synopsis: Marta decides to take her daughters, Agáta and Mína, leave her toxic husband, and start over. She finds refuge in the house of her father, an eccentric loner who has spent his entire life preparing for the end of the world.  Their time together reveals long-suppressed family conflicts, many of them triggered by the husband. When Milan accuses Marta of kidnapping the children, the father drives him away, strengthening the bond with his daughter.

releases.title: Encryption
releases.synopsis: A conspiracy theorist Theo and his niece are looking for answers about Theo's abduction. Following a path of clues left by Theo prior to his memory loss leads them to a hideout of an underground organization nicknamed "Cryp-Tech".

releases.title: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
releases.synopsis: A few mysterious men from Kochi arrive out of nowhere and whisk away the ever-baffling Eken Babu to Kerala. As confusion turns into curiosity, Eken finds himself at the centre of a bizarre new mystery.

releases.title: Krew
releases.synopsis: A young film student joins a foreign horror film shooting in the woods, only to realize she can’t understand the language—or the dark rituals that may claim her as their final sacrifice.

releases.title: The Suitcase
releases.synopsis: During a gala, three friends stumble upon a suitcase filled with money and a dead body. Before they know it, they find themselves caught up in an unexpected and dangerous manhunt.

releases.title: Scum of the Earth
releases.synopsis: A documentary on rural American horror cinema

releases.title: JINX
releases.synopsis: After moving into her new home, Mia, a mute Girl, discovers a cursed dollhouse hidden in the attic. When her younger brother vanishes into thin air, she must unlock the relic's dark mysteries before the ancient hex claims his soul forever.

releases.title: Visitation
releases.synopsis: A plot of land, a house by the lake, its changing inhabitants. This one plot of land reflects 70 years of German history from Weimar, the Nazis, the war, the Soviet occupation and reconstruction to the fall of the GDR.

releases.title: In This Room
releases.synopsis: New movie by Ana Rocha de Souza

releases.title: Rebound
releases.synopsis: Dee rebounds from one, funny failed date to the next, in the search for Mr Right. If only she could see that her best friend is right there all along - it's obvious, right?

releases.title: Bapak Paling Jujur
releases.synopsis: A highly calculated gubernatorial candidate finds his meticulously engineered political campaign and public persona thrown into absolute disarray when a maternal curse renders him entirely incapable of deception, forcing him to navigate the political arena with unfiltered, absolute honesty.

releases.title: Carlo Acutis: The Millennial Saint
releases.synopsis: The documentary unfolds as a journey through the life of Carlo Acutis – from pilgrimages to Assisi to digital communities around the world, up to his canonisation – illustrating the constant dialogue between earthly life and transcendent reality. It shows how the message of "the first saint of the digital age" can transcend religious boundaries and speak to different generations and distant cultures, reaching from his parish in Milan to Cascia, La Verna, Lanciano, Fátima, Rome and many countries around the world, where his words have resonated and been embraced.

releases.title: Emperor vs Sarat Chandra
releases.synopsis: Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, loved for his humanist novels, finds himself at the center of a storm when he writes Pather Dabi—a fierytale of Sabyasachi, a revolutionary whose ideas electrify the youth.

releases.title: Everyone's Sorry Nowadays
releases.synopsis: On a sweltering summer day, Bianca feels unseen by her parents. Then an unexpected encounter with her favourite female actor, Billie King, helps her to find herself. A tender, imaginative tale about dreams and carving out a space for yourself in life.

releases.title: Sin Lives Upstairs
releases.synopsis: In a Portuguese apartment building, two couples share the same structure, yet live in entirely different universes. Iara and Lusa, a Brazilian couple, face the silence and strain of a marriage marked by routine and an emotional distance from each other and their homeland. Upstairs, Pedro and Inês, a younger Portuguese couple, lead an intense relationship fueled by energy, impulsivity, and a still-vibrant intimacy. Between thin walls, sharp banter, and cultural misunderstandings, their co-existence becomes a stage for laughter, unease, and unexpected revelations.

releases.title: Nachts in der Provinz
releases.synopsis: Richard runs a sausage stand at the local sports ground. When a young woman appears, searching for her runaway horse, he is pulled out of his familiar routine. Together, they set off to find it – and an unusual night begins. Elsewhere, as dusk falls, Anna faces a different kind of departure. After one final shift as a pizza delivery driver, she plans to leave her home village for good. But old relationships, village stories and a ghostly encounter make her wonder whether leaving is really that simple.

releases.title: Red Screen
releases.synopsis: A young and ambitious female profiler is trying to interrogate a maniac about his last victim, who might still be alive. However, the serial killer remains unresponsive. The only way to make him talk is to expose him to an effective yet deadly development called "Red Screen." There's just one problem-the profiler has to be the first one to experience "Red Screen".

releases.title: Call Me Queen
releases.synopsis: The film depicts a friendship between an Irish journalist in Kenya and a Rwandan woman, who pair up to combat the AIDS crisis in the 1990s.

releases.title: Inky Pinky Ponky 2
releases.synopsis: Follows Lisa, a successful designer returning for a school reunion, exploring themes of identity, family acceptance, romance with a rugby player, and personal growth within a Tongan-New Zealand community.

releases.title: Youri
releases.synopsis: Amsterdam, 1982. When journalist Jan Brokken meets Youri Egorov – the world-famous Soviet pianist who fled his homeland because of his sexuality – an unexpected friendship begins. Jan, quiet and guarded, is drawn to Youri’s brilliance, excess and freedom; Youri, in turn, recognizes in Jan a kindred outsider. As their bond deepens, Youri inspires Jan the courage to pursue the life he has always postponed: becoming a writer.

releases.title: Je so’ pazzo
releases.synopsis: Je so’ pazzo is an intense portrait of Pino Daniele—a rebellious soul born in the alleys of Naples who revolutionized Italian music by blending blues, jazz, and Neapolitan tradition. The film chronicles his rise, from a childhood marked by abandonment to his legendary 1981 concert before a crowd of 200,000. Amidst family conflicts, personal vulnerabilities, and deep loves, Pino finds a musical language to express what words cannot. Yet success brings new challenges: an unresolved relationship with his father, the burden of expectations, and the risk of repeating past mistakes. It is not merely the story of an extraordinary musician, but that of a man grappling with himself, seeking reconciliation with his roots and the love of a city that never stopped waiting for him.

releases.title: have you seen me?
releases.synopsis: After his beloved cat disappears amidst a global pandemic, a lonely man turns to his neighbor for help. As isolation takes hold, their search becomes a surreal descent into loneliness, longing, and dimensional dissolution.

releases.title: Ana the Cleaner
releases.synopsis: Ana spends her days cleaning the homes of Chicago's elite while feeding an obsession with true crime. When one of her clients suddenly disappears, Ana becomes convinced she's uncovered the perfect murder.

releases.title: Garuda Di Dadaku
releases.synopsis: A thirteen-year-old boy battling severe chronic asthma refuses to abandon his ambitions of joining the Indonesian National Youth Football Team, finding an extraordinary path to athletic rehabilitation through the intervention of a mystical Garuda entity and the strategic support of the head coach's daughter.

releases.title: The Doll Walk
releases.synopsis: When the government attempts to erase trans identities, a group of trans women takes to the streets of New York City, demanding a future where trans people can exist on their own terms.

releases.title: Sally
releases.synopsis: In this short film, gravity plays a trick on us and makes marbles rock and roll through the room, jump over the floor and even stand on their heads.

releases.title: Synthetic
releases.synopsis: The film is based on real-life events. Alena, a voice-over star, suddenly discovers that her voice has been stolen by the developers a major bank's neural network. Now her voice can be heard everywhere—from airport announcements to entertainment and gaming platforms. Alena realizes that in the modern reality a person's voice does not fall under legal protection. Thus, not only voice-over actors but everyone is at risk. The actress starts a struggle for the right to her own voice.

releases.title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
releases.synopsis: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku is the much-awaited sequel to the 2024 all-time blockbuster Bohurupi, where Bikram and Jhimli return, stepping into a thrilling new chapter of adventure and high-stakes drama.

releases.title: Parallel Consequences
releases.synopsis: Max and his friends, Pedro and Bruna, discover a time machine and decide to test it. What begins as an adventure quickly turns into a nightmare when Pedro inexplicably tries to kill Max, who must repeatedly travel back a few seconds in time to survive and uncover the truth. Caught in an unstable timeline, the three friends confront dark truths about themselves, the weight of their choices, and the unpredictable consequences of trying to rewrite destiny.

releases.title: The Illusion of a Quiet Night
releases.synopsis: Filmed during one night in July 2025 by forty filmmakers and hundreds of citizens, The Illusion of a Quiet Night paints a vast collective portrait of war-torn Ukraine. Between fear and exhaustion, moments of joy and scenes of the ordinary day to day, we watch as life goes on in spite of everything, witnessing the resilience of a nation gripped by uncertainty.

releases.title: The Late in Life Guide to Modern Day Lesbianism
releases.synopsis: Congratulations on finally coming out. Equal parts orientation, indoctrination, and camp, this satirical 90s corporate training video onboards "late-in-lifers" with everything you didn't know you needed to survive modern-day lesbianism.

releases.title: Anatomy of Ordinary Crimes
releases.synopsis: This urgent documentary uncovers the real-life, long-term impact of cyber violence and online sexual abuse and how it reshapes lives, communities and our entire digital culture.

releases.title: Boy Mom
releases.synopsis: A nervous woman meets her adult boyfriend's overbearing mother.

releases.title: Junkies of Dreaming
releases.synopsis: Orchestra rehearsals with Teodor Currentzis. The House of the Radio of the GDR in Berlin. A young couple in love. The artistic process viewed from the outside – and from the inside. Mahler’s boundary-breaking Third Symphony. What triggered the composition 130 years ago, and what does it trigger in us today?

releases.title: Dendam Arwah Penari
releases.synopsis: The bankruptcy of Mr. Kusuma’s business forced Harum and her family to move into an old family home. There, Harum discovered a mysterious shawl that turned out to harbor the grudge of a dancer from the past. Since then, a series of terrifying and strange events has begun to haunt Harum and her family. To put an end to this deadly terror, Harum must uncover the mystery behind the dancer’s unjust death.

releases.title: Conscience
releases.synopsis: The filmmakers present the stories of ordinary people across three segments of this anthology film: "Trust," "Frenzy," and "Conscience." The lives of the protagonists have been ruthlessly ground down by a modern-day scourge: fraud.  Much is said and written today about the complex world of information technology and the importance of protecting oneself and one’s loved ones. Yet, not everyone possesses the caution, skepticism, wariness, and high level of awareness needed to stay safe; consequently, people of all ages and social backgrounds fall prey to scammers.

releases.title: Gardener's Planet!
releases.synopsis: A TV Gardener who discovers that the people whose garden he is working on aren't actually people at all but evil aliens from another planet and he has to defeat them before it's too late.

releases.title: The Forest
releases.synopsis: A story about primeval forests - a world of subtle connections that have been formed for thousands of years. Cedars, spruces, firs grow here, and on the European continent, such forests have survived only in the north of Russia.

releases.title: Ruki Vverh! 2
releases.synopsis: Thirty years after the story of the band Ruki Vverkh! began, Sergey Zhukov together with his children revisits memories of his youth: his first love, his first big dreams, friendship, family, and the journey to the stage.

releases.title: Dirty Angel
releases.synopsis: A young woman gets involved in a typhoon of temptation, pressure, buried secrets and dangerous individuals that prowl the nocturnal streets and has to use her internal strength to create a new balance in her shattered life and start living to the fullest once again.

releases.title: La Graciosa - Canarian Dreams
releases.synopsis: The film directors have known La Graciosa, now officially recognized as the eighth island of the Canaries, since 1994. Who could have guessed at the time what dramatic changes the people of La Graciosa would experience over the next three decades?

releases.title: Seven Days of Happiness
releases.synopsis: Prokopiy, a 27-year-old boy with developmental disabilities, lives with his strict mother, Maria, who keeps him locked away for his own "safety." Life goes on as usual in a remote Yakut village until Prokopiy's cheerful sister, Aiyyna, arrives next door. She gives him warmth, attention, and a sense of "normality," and a simple, pure friendship blossoms between them, which becomes a revelation for the boy. Aiyyna leads him out of his locked room, takes him on a sleigh ride to a party, and for the first time makes him feel part of the outside world. But the closer Prokopiy gets to freedom, the more conflicts he has with his mother, who fears losing control and may not be able to protect her son from the pain society can inflict on him. A touching, harsh, and poetic coming-of-age story about a man who emerges from the safety of a locked world to an ambiguous freedom.

releases.title: Autopista América 2000
releases.synopsis: Laura finds herself caught up in a frenzy of mystery and international suspicion when she believes she has discovered that Germans are trying to block her sister Débora's visit from Berlin.

releases.title: I Want to Be Like You
releases.synopsis: New Konstantin Bojanov movie

releases.title: Cathexis
releases.synopsis: In a forgotten Florida panhandle town, a lonely young woman responsible for a murder becomes fixated on inhabiting the mind of the case’s detective as fantasy and reality begin to blur.

releases.title: Low Tide
releases.synopsis: A retirement home by the sea. A storm is brewing. Élodie, 11, visits her grandmother Ismène, who seems lost in the fog of her memories. The young girl fights back against fate with a few notes of music. The fog begins to lift.

releases.title: Quick Fix
releases.synopsis: Norman has been living his life through labels. (literally). Julius is trying to help Norman navigate through his strange "illness."

releases.title: Jebediah: Are We OK?
releases.synopsis: This is the story of a band that grew up but never grew apart. Jebediah's thirty-year journey is a celebration of friendship, creativity, and staying connected against the odds.

releases.title: Cephalopods
releases.synopsis: Set in a distant future within a sprawling metropolis, the animated short film Cefalópodes follows Duda, an insecure beginner drag queen performing in underground bars. The narrative chronicles her tender romantic relationship with Teo, a painter from Saturn's moon, which gradually fades amid heavy silences and emotional misconnections.

releases.title: FREE
releases.synopsis: After the death of his girlfriend, young Leo increasingly withdraws from the world. He isolates himself more and more, living for her instead of himself. But how long can this go on?

releases.title: A Night at Crystal Lake
releases.synopsis: An exclusive preview of A24’s Friday the 13th prequel, Crystal Lake, shown only at New Zealand’s #1 Haunted Attraction, Spookers. Camp Crystal Lake's idyllic summer ends with Jason's death. As the town moves on, Pam keeps searching for him.

releases.title: Dear Debbie
releases.synopsis:
Sometimes, enough is enough…

Debbie Mullen is losing it. For years, she has compiled all of her best advice into her column, Dear Debbie, where the wives of New England come for sympathy and neighborly advice. Through her work, Debbie has heard from countless women who are ignored, belittled, or even abused by their husbands. And Debbie does her best to guide them in the right direction. Or at least, she did.

These days, Debbie’s life seems to be spiraling out of control. She just lost her job. Something strange is happening with her teenage daughters. And her husband is keeping secrets, according to the tracking app she installed on his phone. Now, Debbie’s done being the bigger person.

She’s done being reasonable and practical. It’s time to take her own advice.

And now it’s time for payback against all the people in her life who deserve it the most.

releases.title: Persona
releases.synopsis:
**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

A feral shut-in discovers a disturbing internet porn video of what seems to be herself. A seance of coked-up artists summons unearthly forces in a studio apartment. The staircase of an exurban marketing company descends endlessly beneath the earth. 

In Aoife Josie Clements’ electric, nightmarish, intricately layered novel, the impossibility of goodness crowds in upon two young trans women barely surviving on sex work and zero-hours contracts. Below the familiar evils of capitalism and the bottomless depths of internet culture, a darker horror awaits. What curse follows these women? What are they escaping? What are they running towards?

releases.title: KYOTO lo sguardo del drago
releases.synopsis: Un fantasy thriller, come in un film, dal lusso degli yacht di Portofino ai ruderi di un antico castello in Giappone. Il prezioso pugnale del samurai demone Nobunaga è scomparso. Michele, geniale decifratore di codici segreti, Alexander, affascinante milionario irlandese, Gretel, eclettica signora, e Yoshida, investigatore privato, sono i fantastici quattro che indagano per svelare il mistero in un crescendo da vivere minuto dopo minuto: gli azzardi, i ninja, l'onore e l'amicizia, l'amore e la morte. Tragica e fiabesca, cinica e poetica, una storia dura ammantata di dolcezza ed elegante ironia fino alla spietata soluzione.

releases.title: The Man Who Vanished
releases.synopsis:
**What would you become  if no one could see you?**

A gripping psychological thriller of invisibility, obsession, and power. Deep within Egypt, a discovery changes everything. When I encounter something never meant to be found, my world fractures. I vanish from sight—but not from consequence. Liberation mutates into obsession, freedom into a mind slipping beyond control.

Unseen, I move through the world’s shadows—navigating criminal networks, exposing hidden conspiracies, unearthing truths buried for centuries. Invisibility becomes more than an ability: it becomes temptation, weapon, and curse.

Each step deeper into the unseen erodes the boundaries between justice and transgression, control and compulsion. But the greatest danger is not the enemies I pursue. It is the darkness awakening within me. As curiosity hardens into obsession, morality fractures.

Some hungers leave scars you cannot see. And when power begins to consume rather than empower, survival becomes a battle not only against those who hunt me—but against the consequences of everything I have done. 

The Man Who Vanished is a gripping psychological thriller fused with political intrigue, conspiracies and espionage suspense. Relentless tension meets psychological depth in a story about invisibility, obsession, and the devastating cost of crossing unseen lines.

Perfect for readers who love:

✔ Psychological thrillers
✔ Political and conspiracy thrillers
✔ Espionage and spy fiction
✔ Dark suspense and moral dilemmas
✔ High-stakes international intrigue

Fans of high-tension, mind-bending thrillers and stories of identity, secrecy, and psychological descent will be captivated by its atmosphere, intensity, and escalating suspense. 
Are you ready to vanish into the unseen?

Notice: Contains mature themes and strong scenes intended for mature readers.

releases.title: Titanium, The Life & Memoirs Of Toby Ti Mustard
releases.synopsis: Titanium: Life of X is a raw, visionary memoir by ordained minister and creative leader Toby Ti Mustard. This spiritual autobiography traces a journey of awakening, reincarnation, and resilience — a life forged in silence, shaped by struggle, and elevated by purpose. Set against the backdrop of Ross County, Ohio, Toby’s story unfolds through mystical insight, personal transformation, and a calling to serve. Titanium is not just a book — it’s a declaration of identity, a spiritual blueprint, and a testament to the unbreakable force of becoming.

releases.title: The Beeston Genesis
releases.synopsis: A historical and analytical study examining the role of Robert William Felkin in the formation and codification of modern Western Tarot systems. The paper situates Felkin’s work within the intellectual and social context of Beeston, Nottinghamshire, and traces how these early influences informed later Golden Dawn Tarot structures.

releases.title: My Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Dad
releases.synopsis: This work serves as the primary case study for Sir Jacob Kristopher Anders' research into Digital Provenance and Media Ethics (Ref: Wikidata Q138334536).

releases.title: A Good Person
releases.synopsis:
Lillian and Henry have been enjoying each other’s company, especially in bed. Even though Lillian’s best friend calls it “situationship,” Lillian is determined to lock Henry down—and she has a plan. She’ll be the best, most accommodating version of herself until he falls in love with her. But when Henry blindsides Lillian with a breakup, Lillian exacts revenge by performing a drunken hex on him.

Lillian expects Henry to come crawling back to her. What she doesn’t quite anticipate is becoming a prime suspect in his murder case when he’s found dead. As Lillian grapples with the loss of her sort-of-boyfriend, she’s hit with another reckoning: That Henry had a long-term girlfriend he also left behind.

Desperate to control the narrative, clear her name, and assume her rightful place as Henry’s mourning girlfriend, Lillian’s pursuit of the truth will throw her into a dangerous tailspin.

releases.title: Tiny Steps Giant Leaps
releases.synopsis:
The book '**Tiny Steps Giant Leaps**' was written by the author **Chowdhury Tauhid Mahmud** aka Radi. He has expertise in teaching children for around two decades. He came up with this book, so that readers can come back to the habit of reading books and naturally stays away from screen time as much as possible. 
The book is unique because the readers have to read and write lots of activities which will help to boost their creativity.

releases.title: The Escape Game
releases.synopsis:
**It’s all fun and games until someone ends up dead.**

Six months ago, season four of The Escape Game ended in horror when contestant Alicia Angelos was found murdered on set.

Now season five is underway, and new contestants are ready to put their skills to the test solving the show's trickiest escape rooms. There's Adi, the cryptographer; Carter, the math whiz; Beck, the wannabe game master; and . . . Sierra Angelos, the girl who got away with her sister’s murder. Or so everyone believes.

But Sierra’s not just here to win. She’s here for justice.

When the contestants begin uncovering clues that hint at the identity of Alicia’s true killer, it becomes clear that the stakes aren’t high just in this competition—they’re deadly. If these teens want to win—and survive—the game, they must solve the biggest mystery of all: who killed Alicia Angelos?

releases.title: In the Periphery of It All
गुनहग़ार (Gunehgar)
releases.synopsis:
"क्या कोई गुनाह इतना बड़ा हो सकता है कि खुदा की रहमत कम पड़ जाए?"
यह कहानी है फ़ैज़ की, जिसके लिए एक थप्पड़ सिर्फ एक पल की बेइज्जती नहीं थी, बल्कि उसके पूरे वजूद की हार बन गई थी. ज़ोया से किया गया वह इंतिक़ाम उसे एक ऐसे मोड़ पर ले आता है, जहाँ मंज़िल अब कोई मंज़िल नहीं, बल्कि खुद की तलाश है.
यह महज़ एक प्रेम कहानी नहीं है, बल्कि नफरत की आग से शुरू होकर सजदों की शांति तक पहुँचने वाला एक गहरा सफ़र है. फ़ैज़ की गलतियाँ उसे ऐसी गलियों में ले जाती हैं जहाँ पछतावा ही उसका इकलौता साथी है

releases.title: Of Darkness and Desecration
releases.synopsis:
I could cling to hope or hate…
That night, I chose hope.
But I kept hate close by.
Just in case.

The second novel in the Harbingers of Agatharr series continues as our heroes converge.

Celeste, the Herald of Valitharr, races toward the ancient spellweaver stronghold of Lirathmar. But the divine being who whispers in her mind has been called to stand before the Pantheon, and Celeste worries she won’t survive the journey without him.

Caelen, a timid peasant, blames himself for the horrors that have befallen his loved ones and vows never to be paralyzed by fear again. His newfound eagerness finds him in possession of a powerful, ancient ability that threatens to sunder his mind unless he learns to control it.

Brynna, a hardened blacksmith, has sworn to protect Caelen and return him to the remnants of his family in Mossby. But in a world cursed with magic, even the simplest task can be marred by danger.

Their paths have merged, but how do they trust those they barely know when death lurks in every shadow?

releases.title: Love and Other Curses
releases.synopsis:
For the Kingdom. For the magic. And for love . . .

Aurelia Wycherley has found someone to tether her magic to – her enigmatic former enemy, Jules Nightly. Now, they are heading off to coven college to learn advanced magic. But they are also on a secret to discover the Lost Quarter of the college, create their own coven of twelve and try to discover a way to bring back the Old Magic. 

When malevolent magic interrupts their first night at college, Aurelia and Jules discover that Jonathan and his coven of untethered witches has escaped and now they are after her magic, curse and all… 

Can they save the magic and the world - or will Aurelia lose her magic for good?

Prepare for balls, late-night study groups, hidden mysteries, a heist, the return of old foes, and a lot more kissing!

releases.title: Oceanforged
releases.synopsis:
*From the bestselling author of The Grandest Bookshop in the World comes the second instalment of an epic fantasy adventure series in the tradition of Skandar and Percy Jackson.* 

Guided by a mysterious message, Cori, Tarn and Jem sail north to meet the secretive Loyalists, who will help them on their quest for the Oceanforged Armour.

Instead, the Loyalists warn of a looming disaster. Unless Cori can master all the powers of the Champions before it strikes, Aquinta will be doomed.

The Loyalists believe that a piece of armour may be hidden in Mutemount. But sea monsters once lurked in those waters, and no one who has travelled near the silent island in the last century has ever returned…

releases.title: The Writers Retreat
releases.synopsis:
**A wickedly twisty and atmospheric thriller set at a writers' retreat in the South of France, The Writers Retreat is Knives Out meets Anna Downes’ The Safe Place from an exciting new voice in the thriller/mystery space.**

Welcome to The Writers Retreat – a creative haven for writers to hone their plotlines and sharpen their characters while soaking up the Provençal atmosphere. But this year’s retreat offers something different, as real-life blurs with fiction, and suspense isn't contained to the page.

Kat Hale is a bestselling Australian author crumbling under the pressure of writing her second novel. On a whim, she has fled to a writers retreat in the South of France run by internationally acclaimed author Helen Thorne. What Kat hopes will be two blissfully uninterrupted weeks to focus on her writing in anonymity quickly turns into something more sinister, when Kat begins to suspect that Helen isn't quite as perfect as everyone seems to believe.

Will Kat’s drive to uncover the truth about Helen be any match for Helen’s desire to hold onto her career, her reputation and her writing retreat, or is Kat at risk of falling victim to a more dangerous climax?

releases.title: The Radiant Dark
releases.synopsis:
***Arrival meets Wild Dark Shore in this captivating novel that follows a family for over fifty years—a bold and compassionate exploration of the universe around us and what it truly means to be human.***

It’s March 1980, and Carol Girard and her husband are living an ordinary life in a small town in the Adirondacks. They have just had their first child, and though Carol is struggling with the challenges of new motherhood, her future seems clear. Until something extraordinary happens: an inexplicable flickering of light in the sky, which is ultimately determined to be communication from intelligent life on another planet. Intoxicating substances can be found lurking in every corner of modern life, and Matthew Perkins-McVey’s pathbreaking book offers the untold story of how they were implicated in shifting perceptions of embodiment found in the emerging sciences of the body and mind in late-nineteenth-century Germany. Their use in this experimental context gave rise to a dynamic conception of the subject within the scientific, psychological, philosophical, and sociological milieu of the era. The history of the modern biological subject, Perkins-McVey argues, turns on “intoxicated ways of knowing.”
 
Intoxicated Ways of Knowing identifies the state of intoxication as a tacit form of thinking and knowing with the body. Intoxicants force us to feel, intervening directly in our perceptional awareness, and, Perkins-McVey contends, they bring latent conceptual associations into the foreground of conscious thought, engendering new ways of knowing the world. The book unfurls how intoxicants affected nineteenth-century German science and how, ultimately, the connection between mental life and intoxication is taken up in the works of Friedrich Nietzsche, Max Weber, and Sigmund Freud, bringing the biological subject out of the lab and into the worlds of philosophy, psychoanalysis, sociology, and politics.

releases.title: Innocence, Desire, and the Architecture of the Fall
releases.synopsis:
ABSTRACT
Across John Hawkes’s seventeen novels, the word “grape” appears 129 times, concentrated in the mature “triad” novels and codified in Innocence in Extremis (1985). But the grape does not operate alone. Systematic analysis of seventeen novels reveals a five-part symbolic architecture that existing scholarship has overlooked: the grape functions as threshold catalyst, surrounded by four counter-motifs, camera (1,173 keyword hits), wound (1,814 keyword hits), enclosure (3,167 keyword hits), and child/death (5,569 keyword hits), forming a repeating system whose keywords appear thousands of times across the corpus, markers of motif concentration rather than precise measures of symbolic function. These counts identify where the motifs cluster; they do not quantify symbolic density, and the comparative prevalence figures (child > enclosure > wound > camera > grape) reflect keyword concentration, not confirmed symbolic operation. This study integrates close reading with systematic text analysis to reveal Hawkes as more deliberately architectural, more internally consistent, than anyone has recognized. The debris of his fiction reveals its innate design.

releases.title: Vanirya Legends

The game also features pets, expeditions, castle defense, guilds, a player market, and player-versus-player battles.

Mimics create their disguise using simple 3D modeling tools and Busters hunt the Mimics before the time runs out!

releases.title: Toy Story 3: Complete Edition
releases.synopsis: Toy Story 3: Complete Edition brings the definitive version of the game inspired by the Academy Award-winning film to modern platforms for the first time, including previously platform-exclusive content from the PlayStation 3 version and an enhanced experience with upgraded visuals, higher resolutions and improved performance. Toy Story 3 is best known for its groundbreaking Toy Box Mode, a massive, open-world sandbox that allowed customization of the environment and characters and featured non-linear missions that allow players to unlock new toys, vehicles and characters from other Pixar movies.

releases.title: Toy Story: Retro Roundup!

Melody Green saw something she shouldn't have.

A music teacher at a local elementary school finds herself in the midst of something bizarre and unexplainable: an abandoned building, a thick fog enveloping the area, and no wi-fi or phone signal to allow her to call for help.

Faced with strange riddles, eerie messages from her past, and something horrible haunting her from within the screens, Melody realizes that someone or something is calling out to her, trying to show her a truth that could shatter her world and turn her life completely upside down.
